verdict.rationale: Turso documents a public Platform API for programmatically managing databases, groups, organizations, and tokens. Its docs explicitly describe creating, token-scoping, and tearing down per-agent databases through that API, and a fetch-based HTTP package also exists. missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probes of the common openapi/swagger paths returned 404), endpoint-level depth in the evidence, and independent hands-on corroboration of API use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Programmatically manage databases, groups, organizations, and tokens with the Turso Platform API.
Each entity gets its own isolated SQLite database that you create, token-scope, and tear down via the API.
The `@tursodatabase/serverless` package connects to Turso using only the `fetch` API
